c74object.name: evi.korgms20.select~
c74object.digest: Korg OTA dual-amplifier buffered modified Sallen-Key topology nonlinear filter emulation
c74object.description:
evi.korgms20.select~ is a 'max define' for the evi_korgms20_select.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.korgms20.select~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
The 'KLM' OTA chip was found in the later MS-20s and other Korg synthesisers - it is different to the earlier 'Korg 35' single-amplifier unbuffered Korg chip found in the earlier MS-20s and MS-10 and also in the 'monotron' series. This is a fabricated evieve version able to smoothly switch (with a nice 'plop') between 12dB LP and 6dB HP filter types, realised in transposed TPT form. With 2x oversampling option.

outlet.digest: Outlet #1: Korg OTA S&K LP or HP Filter
outlet.description: 12dB lowpass (default) or 6dB highpass depending on @filter attribute.

attribute.name: filter
attribute.description: Select filter output type. 0 (default) = 12dB lowpass, 1 = 6dB highpass.

attribute.name: filtersmooth
attribute.description: If @filtersmooth is > 0., switching the filter type between 12dB lowpass and 6dB highpass is smoothed for realtime switching. This can result in a nice 'plop'.

attribute.name: oversample
attribute.description: If on (the default) the filter is 2x oversampled. If off (0), the filter runs at samplerate. Oversampling is highly recommended to deal with the nonlinear behaviour of the filter.
